facts.text: I came here to forget my ex, and she's at the next table. I'm ordering the biggest cocktail on the menu and staying put.
facts.why: Invented speech for Peter. In the film he finds Sarah in the resort lobby and later gets a room next to hers, and the sources I opened do not put her at the next table. A real Peter line from the lobby scene fits and is funnier.
facts.fix: I came here to murder you.

fix_note.text: I came here to murder you.

facts.text: Do less, says Chuck. Just eat.
facts.why: In the transcript the surf instructor Chuck (Koonu) tells Peter 'Do less' over and over during the surf lesson, so the joke matches the film.
facts.fix: Surf lessons with Kunu. Just eat.

vibe.verdict: A relaxed beach kiosk with the right Hawaiian food and a surf report gag, though the best Peter and Rachel scenes are missing.
